_help: Edit these values, then run: node build.mjs. Empty values are switched off.
_tracking: GA4 id looks like G-XXXXXXX, Meta Pixel id is a 15-16 digit number, Clarity id is ~10 letters/numbers
_booking: Calendly link (e.g. https://calendly.com/yourname/strategy-call) opens as a popup. Any other link (e.g. Cal.com) opens in a new tab. Empty = buttons go to the contact page.
_search: From Google Search Console > Add property > HTML tag: paste only the content="..." value
